title: 1/4 C chili powder
ingredients: 1 15 oz can light red kidney beans, drained and rinsed

Medium-high heat, cook the ground beef with onion, bell pepper, and celery until beef is browned and vegetables are soft (about 8-10 minutes). Drain excess fat. Return mixture to the pot. Add tomato juice,
Tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, kidney beans, chili beans, and all seasonings.
instructions: Stir well and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 2 to 3 hours, stirring occasionally.
For chicken or turkey ground - cook separate first with tomato paste and dash of soy sauce and remove. Add Worcestershire sauce to the chili 1tbsp.
For Lamb ground - add 1- 1.5 tbsp each coriander, cumin, smoked paprika during ground lamb cooking and 1/4 tsp cinnamon before simmer
Pork shoulder 1/2 inch cubes sear hard then proceed normal
